biggest_catch: Variable gig pay (85% of your own rate after the 15% commission) with no guaranteed bookings — and it is a Europe/UK-focused platform.
catches: Holidog takes a 15% commission on confirmed bookings — you keep 85% of your set rate.
Sitters set their own rates, so pay is variable with no guaranteed bookings.
Europe/UK-focused platform; demand varies by city.
Must keep bookings on-platform to retain Holidog Protection and vet coverage.
Earnings depend on profile quality, reviews, and local demand.

steps: Sign up free on Holidog as a pet sitter.
Create your profile and choose services: boarding, house sitting, cat visits, dog walking.
Receive requests, message owners for free, confirm routines and timing.
Confirm bookings on Holidog; Holidog takes 15% commission and you keep the rest.
timing: Paid per confirmed/completed booking via the platform.
